editorial:
Imagine being stuck in a nightmare where you die over and over, but each time you wake up smarter and stronger. That is the wild ride waiting for you in this sci-fi action hit. Tom Cruise plays Major Bill Cage, an officer who has never seen real combat. When he is thrown into a brutal war against alien invaders, he dies almost instantly. But a strange twist of fate sends him back to the start of the same day every time he dies. With the help of a tough soldier named Rita, played by Emily Blunt, he trains, learns, and fights his way to win. The vibe is like a video game mixed with a war movie.

The action is fast, loud, and easy to follow, and humor keeps things light. Tom Cruise and Emily Blunt have great chemistry, and you will care about what happens to them. The only downside is that the ending feels a little rushed. Still, if you love action movies with a clever twist, this one is for you. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for best picture and sound.
endingExplained: Cage and Rita finally reach the alien queen, the Omega, hidden underwater. Cage kills it but dies in the process. Because he had the alien blood in him, killing the Omega resets time one last time. He wakes up before the invasion even begins, with all his memories intact. The war is won before it starts, and he finds Rita alive and well, ready to fight again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action movies with a clever sci-fi twist.
